checks.evidence: Ran EPS vs CTRL; in-vitro EPS model is the paper's primary design (FIG1).
EPS 4 / CTRL 3 matches FIG1 n; titles L* / CL* agree with characteristic; 7/7 aligned, no exclusions.
Single two-group fit, ~grp; paper's edgeR on counts blocked because only CPM deposited, declared deviation.
Only one varying factor; no batch recorded.
CPM columns sum to 1e6, no counts deposited; not rounded back to counts; limma on log2(CPM+1) declared, plus CPM-filter sensitivity.

Results rule (P<0.01, |log2FC|>1, strict) applied, Methods rule (P<0.001, >=) as audit; both discrepancies in the record. Flag: raw p<0.01 alone gives 794 vs 774 but that is a count coincidence on a different method.
218 vs 774 reported with caveats (limma on CPM, +1 offset compresses fold change); HANDBACK does not claim agreement.
No stop or refusal; edgeR route 'blocked' reason (CPM only, no counts) is true per matrix gate.

human_items: 论文数字(774)与单独的 P<0.01(794)最接近,而非其声明的 P<0.01 且 FC>2:该情形下应报告哪条阈值属开放政策问题,本案已记录两条论文规则,未发现违反技能规则。
summary: EPS 对 CTRL(4 vs 3)对比、方向、分组与论文一致;论文结果与方法两处阈值不一致,已分别作为主规则和审计规则记录。因只有 CPM 无计数,edgeR 路线受阻,改用 limma(log2(CPM+1))并作声明偏离,218 对 774 的差异已如实说明。
